5060101.text: This Commercial Street bulletin board was set up by the Shogunate. Notices of all kinds will be posted here. Do not post without authorization.

5060201.text: A number of suspicious outlanders have entered Inazuma lately, wandering around with seemingly sinister motives.

5060202.text: The Shogunate hereby notifies everyone: those who report suspicious persons will be rewarded, while those who harbor them will be punished!

5060203.text: Glory to the Shogun and her everlasting reign!

5060301.text: The Vision Hunt Decree operation is coming to an end, but those who conceal their Visions still remain.

5060302.text: Following the orders of the Tenryou Commissioner, and in compliance with the command of Madam Kujou Sara, pursuit operations will avoid using force or disrupting the public as much as possible.

5060303.text: Please don't worry. The Tenryou Commission will not use its public duties as an excuse to intrude on your daily lives.

5060304.text: The Tenryou Commissioner guarantees this in his own name, and that of the Kujou Clan.

5060401.text: "Kujou Tengu! I'm here on the Commercial Street. Stop hiding!"

5060402.text: "Crawl out of whatever hole you're in and fight me fair and square!"

5060403.text: "This one's for taking my Vision away! An eye for an eye!"

5060404.text: Everyone, no need to worry! This fellow is just a small-time hooligan.

5060405.text: Madam Kujou Sara promises that she has nothing to do with this person and that she will handle these messages immediately.

5060501.text: "Though this is not a serious matter, I still hope that it will become more common knowledge."

5060502.text: "The other day, I accidentally lost the only extant copy of the famous 'Toki Alley Tales,' written by Takizawa Kyouden."

5060503.text: "Though it's nothing major, Lady Yae still insisted that I post a lost book notice to look for it. Ah, what a headache..."

5060504.text: "That poor book has probably had its pages scattered to the winds by now... I don't suppose it would be possible to find it at this point."

5060505.text: "It really is nothing of note, but if anyone could help recover it, you will have the Yae Publishing House's thanks."

5060601.text: "I am about to leave my parents and sister. Though I come from a martial family, the thought of war still makes me uneasy."

5060602.text: "Is the war really necessary? Will Her Excellency the Ogosho really take responsibility for the war and for every one of us?"

5060603.text: "As a samurai, perhaps now is not the time for doubt."

5060604.text: A samurai should never have cold feet before a battle, nor should they doubt our Shogun's decisions.

5060605.text: I urge you to turn yourself in for posting inappropriate messages in public. You will receive a lighter sentence of detainment and re-education.

5060606.text: Removing or defiling this message is prohibited.

5060701.text: Citizens of Inazuma, please stay alert while traveling at night. A monster in the form of a tanuki has been spotted around the city lately.

5060702.text: This monster appears to be infant-sized. It moves very quickly and is quite fierce!

5060703.text: Please report to a nearby Doushin or to the Tenryou Commission upon seeing it!

5060704.text: "I've told you, it's not a tanuki! Not a tanuki! Not. A. Tanuki. You hear!?"

5060801.text: "Due to the current situation, Ogura Textiles & Kimonos is going through some tough times. We can't just sit here and do nothing."

5060802.text: "Miss Ogura's father was once a relative of the Kujou Clan. If we don't help each other, that would put the samurai name to shame."

5060803.text: "Please don't worry, Miss Ogura. We'll round up some old friends, and we'll help you get through this tough time."

5060804.text: "I really appreciate your kindness on my late father's account, but I am afraid I must decline."

5060805.text: "I don't want to trouble everyone over such a small matter. I am sure that my brother and I can make it through."

5060806.text: "Miss Ogura, you really are just like your father."

5060901.text: Please do not post notices everywhere!

5060902.text: Anyone found posting notices without authorization will be punished!

5061001.text: "Ms. Kozue of the Komore Teahouse is very lovely."

5061002.text: "Although she has a sharp tongue, a bad temper, and it really hurts when she hits you with the back of her sword..."

5061004.text: The local Police Station has already opened a file based on a lawsuit lodged by Miss Kozue. Please report any leads that you may have.

5061005.text: This message will be used for handwriting recognition. Removing or defiling it is prohibited.

5061102.text: Please don't make such terrible jokes!

5061201.text: "I visited Kamisato Ayato earlier and was surprised at how young he is."

5061202.text: "Compared to his sister Kamisato Ayaka, he is a lot more determined and mature. With a family head like him, the Kamisato clan surely has a bright future."

5061203.text: "Thank you for your kind words about my brother."

5061302.text: Crimes committed: Absconding, robbery, night-time assaults, conspiring against officials, distributing belongings to innocent villagers to incite rebellion.

5061303.text: Wanted dead or alive with a generous bounty!

5061402.text: Crimes committed: Absconding, riotous assembly, piracy, robbing officials, ambushing samurai, holding family members as hostages in an attempt to rebel against the Shogunate.

5061403.text: This person and his accomplices are wanted dead or alive with a generous bounty!

5061501.text: "Thanks to the careful consideration of Tenryou Commissioner Kujou Takayuki, the Vision Hunt Decree was implemented swiftly, preventing those who opposed it from fleeing."

5061502.text: "The real estate assets of the fugitives will be rented out or sold today. The Tenryou Commission guarantees the legitimacy of these transactions!"

5061601.text: With the permission of Guuji Yae Miko, the Grand Narukami Shrine will provide help to those businesses and families affected by the war in the form of aid loans and food aid.

5061602.text: We ask that those in need of help visit the Kamisato Clan to file the required paperwork.

5061603.text: As the war continues and public funds become more tight, food aid will be reduced by half. We apologize for any inconvenience.

5061604.text: "I'd just like to say a big thank you to Lady Yae and the Yashiro Commissioner for their consideration. It's just that there are way too many people here everyday for food aid..."

5061605.text: "People are not receiving the daily allotment of food aid that they are supposed to. What should we do..."

5061606.text: I am sorry, but we don't have a better way. Lady Yae and the Commissioner are doing their best to handle the situation.

5061701.text: The fight against the rebels proceeds apace. Only one more strike, and they shall be destroyed completely.

5061702.text: We hope that all young samurai will join together and fight to accomplish this great work!

5061703.text: Come join the army! Or you may regret not having done anything for your country when the war is over!

5061704.text: Please visit the Tenryou Commission for information about joining the army.

5061705.text: Attention! Families that have received draft orders must send at least one adult to join the military.

5061706.text: "This war is a monster that devours people..."

5061707.text: What right do those who haven't joined the army have to criticize the war effort? It's because the rebels have been defeated that you are able to sit here and whine!

5061708.text: "Is that so? My husband wounded my younger brother on Yashiori Island. He may never walk again."

5061709.text: "I haven't heard anything from my husband since then... Perhaps he was killed by some rebel? And who's to say that that rebel was never once an honorable samurai?"

5061710.text: "Forgive me, but I do not see the point of this war. I will no longer send people to join the army."

5061711.text: Just because these posts are anonymous doesn't mean you are free to spread slander. Such anti-war sentiment is naught but part of the Sangonomiya rebel's propaganda campaigns!

5061712.text: Defacing of military draft notices is prohibited! Anyone caught will face severe punishment!

5061801.text: "The Yae Publishing House's reader's forum will take place as planned. All are welcome, regardless of whether they come from territories controlled by the Shogunate or the rebels!"

5061802.text: Even though the ongoing war is a bitter one, Lady Yae Miko ensures equal treatment for all on account of sharing a common hobby.

5061803.text: As a major publishing house, isn't welcoming rebels to a leisure activity a bit much?

5061804.text: So long as our great Shogun doesn't forbid it, then it's perfectly fine. Shouldn't the Tenryou Commission refrain from making controversial remarks?

5061805.text: Besides, it seems a little out of order to label those who merely live under the dictatorship of the rebels "traitors."

5061901.text: "I have taken a short break from the frontline on Yashiori Island to come home. My parents seem to have gotten a lot older, while my wife looks very exhausted."

5061902.text: "I feel very guilty about not spending more time with my family because of the war..."

5061903.text: "Inazuma seems to have become a lot more quiet. Friends who used to be talkative are now mostly silent."

5061904.text: "Strange. I thought my family would enjoy the war stories that I had sent home."

5062001.text: "I, Tatsunosuke, hereby announce that the military strategy dojo will be permanently shut down starting today."

5062002.text: "The Path of the Sword is an art meant to protect others. It should not be used to kill our brothers."

5062003.text: "Lately, I have witnessed a lot of my disciples fighting against each other. Though I am no saint, my conscience was still pricked by it."

5062004.text: "It's time to put a stop to all this."

5062005.text: "This is why I am shutting the military strategy dojo down, and why I shall never reopen it. I've also forbidden my disciples from serving the Kujou Clan."

5062101.text: "Despite this long period of peace, it seems that few are altogether willing to fight on behalf of our lords..."

5062102.text: "But if the eldest son of Lord Kujou is already on the frontline, then what have we to complain about?"

5062103.text: "And I've heard that Lord Masahito is an honorable man who looks after his soldiers. I wish I could be assigned to his command."

5062104.text: "Madam Kujou Sara is also a good commander... although she is famously strict with her soldiers, at least she is fair and no selfish motives."

5062105.text: "Leaders like them are rare in the Tenryou Commission..."

5062106.text: "I will stop talking about my superiors now, I think. Dear parents, please don't worry. I will come home triumphant soon, and I will bring our family honor!"

5062201.text: "If it were up to me, I would expel all the outlanders in Ritou!"

5062202.text: "The war just won't end, and the Vision Hunt Decree remains in effect. I find it hard to believe that the outlanders have no hand in this at all!"

5062203.text: "Those outlanders must have some way of smuggling Visions and rebels into our country..."

5062204.text: "If only we could make the Sakoku Decree more strict. All these problems would be gone!"

5062205.text: Please don't spread rumors and defame outlanders!

5062206.text: The Vision Hunt Decree and the suppression of the rebels are also going very smoothly!
